title: Pay for a proxy so JobSpy can read ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor?
detail: On GitHub's servers ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor block every JobSpy search (403) and Google returns nothing; LinkedIn is partly rate-limited (429). Fixing it needs a paid residential proxy. Until then the ChatGPT ZIPRECRUITER_WEEKLY lane is the only ZipRecruiter coverage and must stay.
options: Buy a proxy and then retire the lane
recommended: Keep the lane; a proxy costs money every month for one source.
action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
